shared_elements: human head with patterned/striated wig or headdress
justification: Both show human figures with wig-like head coverings accompanied by rows of incised script-like signs, which is a reasonably specific shared pairing of figure plus inscription. However, A is a modelled three-dimensional figure seen close up with hatched wig texture and no legible scene relationships, while B is a flat register composition of several linear, schematic standing figures facing one another beneath a band of signs, so relationships, arrangement and drawing conventions differ almost entirely.
